post.title: Declarative Fedora CoreOS servers with Podman Quadlets
post.subtitle: Reproducible self-hosting without a container orchestrator or configuration drift.
post.content:
This post is being written.

I’ll cover the Fedora CoreOS provisioning flow, organizing Quadlet units, managing secrets and persistent data, and operating a collection of self-hosted services without giving up declarative configuration.
